title: 2009 HMMT November Guts Problem 5
statement: Tanks has a pile of 5 blue cards and 5 red cards. Every morning, he takes a card and throws it down a well. What is the probability that the first card he throws down and the last card he throws down are the same color?

solutions.text:
| \(\frac{4}{9}\) | Once he has thrown the first card down the well, there are 9 remaining cards, and only |
| :---: | :---: | 4 have the same color as the card that was thrown down. Therefore, the probability that the last card he throws down has the same color is \(\frac{4}{9}\).
